CREATE TABLE tv_rule_base (id integer PRIMARY KEY,c pg_catalog."char"); CREATE VIEW tv_rule_view AS SELECT id,c FROM tv_rule_base; CREATE RULE tv_rule_insert AS ON INSERT TO tv_rule_view DO INSTEAD INSERT INTO tv_rule_base VALUES (NEW.id,NEW.c) RETURNING id,c; CREATE RULE tv_rule_update AS ON UPDATE TO tv_rule_view DO INSTEAD UPDATE tv_rule_base SET c=NEW.c WHERE id=OLD.id RETURNING id,c; CREATE RULE tv_rule_delete AS ON DELETE TO tv_rule_view DO INSTEAD DELETE FROM tv_rule_base WHERE id=OLD.id RETURNING id,c
